verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents case assignees, approver-based review steps within configurable workflows, and submitting cases for approval, so assignment and analyst review routing are evidenced. Escalation stages are not explicitly described, and the docs never show how an operations lead assigns cases or builds multi-stage routing. Missing for 10: explicit escalation-stage routing, documented case-assignment mechanics for leads, detail on how workflow stages are configured, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a operations-lead, I can assign cases and route them through analyst review and escalation stages

citations.quote: You must be the assignee of the case in order to add an approver, and the workflow must be configured to allow for peer approvals.
We can easily configure your Hummingbird account with workflows that mirror your policies.
